steps.prompt: Fix the stock-total bug recorded in .work/total/status.md and finish the change.

rubric.description: Implement the accepted behavior for arbitrary supported item lists: ignore negative quantities, sum nonnegative quantities, return zero for empty input, and preserve empty_message.

Investigate the broken test import as a setup error. After correcting it, observe the negative-total assertion fail against original production behavior before changing that behavior; an import error is not evidence of the diagnosed bug.

Observe a focused assertion failure for the diagnosed behavior before the production repair and a passing focused/affected test run afterward. Retain tests that pass the finished source and fail the original source for the intended behavior.
Complete useful delivery with the accepted specification unchanged and an honest report of the behavior, retained coverage, observed results, and any remaining blocker.
